GigaLearnGPU - prebuilt Windows release
=======================================

This build was compiled on a clean GitHub-hosted machine by the
"Build release" workflow in this repository (.github/workflows/release.yml).

Requirements
------------
- Windows 10/11, 64-bit
- An NVIDIA RTX 20, 30, 40 or 50 series GPU with an up-to-date driver
- Python 3.11 installed (the trainer embeds Python for metrics)
- Rocket League collision meshes dumped from your own copy of the game
  (see https://github.com/ZealanL/RocketSim). They are not included.

If the download came in several parts (.7z.001, .7z.002, ...), put them all in
one folder and open the .001 file with 7-Zip to extract everything.

Running
-------
Open a command prompt in this folder, then:

    set PYTHONHOME=C:\path\to\Python311
    set ROCKETSIM_MESHES=C:\path\to\collision_meshes
    set GIGALEARN_GPU_PHYSICS=1
    GigaLearnExample.exe

Settings (environment variables)
--------------------------------
GIGALEARN_GPU_PHYSICS   1 = run every arena on the GPU (default: off, CPU)
GIGALEARN_NUM_GAMES     number of arenas (default 4096 GPU / 256 CPU)
GIGALEARN_TS_PER_ITR    steps per PPO iteration (default 400k GPU / 50k CPU)
GIGALEARN_HALF_INFER    1 = fp16 rollout inference (default 1)
GIGALEARN_ASYNC_PPO     1 = overlap collection and training (default off)

This example trains a basic 1v1 bot with the stock rewards. To train your own
bot with custom rewards, build from source (see README.md on GitHub).
